_comment: Feature inventory for scripts/compare-env.mjs (npm run compare).
Every entry is loaded on BOTH environments and compared side by side.
FOUR signed-in pages, deliberately — Homepage, My Courses, Account and
Competency. Public pages, the signup wizard and step-by-step journeys are NOT
compared: a learner's own pages are where a release regression shows up.
Both sides sign in as the SAME ORG's user. Production and staging are separate
backends, so each has its own account and they are paired by org:
npm run create:pair -- BNRC            one account on each environment
npm run compare:bnrc                   compare as that pair
npm run compare -- --auth --org SHSB   any other org
id     — short slug, used in filenames and the report anchor
name   — the feature label shown in the report
path   — path appended to each environment's base URL
auth   — true = only captured when the run is authenticated (--auth)
wait   — extra settle time in ms after networkidle (slow widgets)
note   — one line shown in the report saying what this entry covers
steps  — actions to walk INTO the screen before capturing. Read-only by
design: click and type to REACH a screen, never submit anything.
{ "click": "My Certificates" }  button name, visible text, or css/xpath
{ "fill": "<selector>", "value": "…" }
{ "waitFor": "Your Learning Plan" }
skip   — set true to park a route without deleting it
ignore — regex patterns for known third-party noise; matching console errors
and failing requests are dropped before the diff.

routes.name: Homepage
routes.note: The signed-in home: "Your Learning Plan (N)" competency cards with their level steppers, plus the course rails.

routes.name: My Courses — For You
routes.note: Captured on the FOR YOU tab, not the default Started tab: Started is empty for a fresh comparison account on both sides, so the old capture compared two blank panels. For You carries the org mapping, which is what differs between environments.

routes.name: Account page
routes.note: Account → Personal Details, with the organisation / academic / language / certificate tabs alongside. Nothing is saved.

routes.name: Competency tab
routes.note: The competency passbook as it lands — levels are not opened.
